correctness.rationale: The admissible derivations are exactly D_f=f d/dx with m x^(m-1)f=0. The kernel of multiplication by a valuation-s element is (x^(m-s)); the image of the formal derivative is spanned by x^(i-1) for 1<=i<=m-1 and p not dividing i. Their intersection gives rank t-floor(t/p), and valuation counts give the exact multiplicities. The endpoint when p divides m is explicitly checked.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete closed rank distribution for all derivations of the natural one-variable truncated local algebra over every finite field. Rank determines fixed-space dimension, and the formula makes the characteristic-dependent rank collisions and the p|m boundary explicit. It is a uniform classification across all truncation lengths, not an arbitrary finite slice.
